parameters.name: CategoryCode
parameters.description: The category of the check item.

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description: The language. Valid values: zh-CN, en-US.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The query token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.
